sentences.pc_only: This can only be done on the PC itself.
sentences.card_title: Jarvis wants to connect a new device

phone.not_mesh: Pairing only works over Tailscale or NordVPN Meshnet. Turn one on, on this phone and on your PC.
phone.this_pc: Pairing is for another device - this PC already has its own key.
phone.wrong_proof: That code is not right. {n} tries left.
phone.wrong_proof_one: That code is not right. 1 try left.
phone.wrong_proof_none: That code is not right, and it no longer works. On your PC, press Pair a phone again.
phone.claimed: Another device already used this code. On your PC, deny the card it raised, then press Pair a phone again.
phone.gone: This code no longer works. On your PC, press Pair a phone again.
phone.name: Use a shorter name, with letters and numbers only.
phone.bad_request: Your PC did not understand this phone's request. Start again on the PC.
phone.card: Your PC could not show the approval card. Try again.
phone.words_differ: The PC answered with different words. Do not approve the card on your PC.
phone.waiting: Approve the card on your PC if it shows these same words.
phone.denied: You said no on your PC. Nothing changed on this phone.
phone.collect_gone: The card on your PC ran out of time or was cancelled. Start again on the PC.
phone.qr_invalid: That is not a Jarvis pairing code.
phone.qr_newer: This code is from a newer Jarvis - update the app.
phone.code_invalid: The code is 8 letters and numbers, like K7QM-4TXD.
phone.camera: Jarvis uses the camera only to read the code on your PC. Nothing is recorded or sent.

key.device_removed: This phone's key was removed on your PC, so Jarvis no longer answers it. Pair again with the QR code in Settings, Devices, on your PC.
key.shared_retired: This phone was using the old shared key, which has been retired on your PC. Pair it with the QR code in Settings, Devices, on your PC.
key.shared_first_pair_only: This PC gives every device its own key now, so the old shared key works on this PC only. Pair this phone with the QR code in Settings, Devices, on your PC.

session.waiting_for_card: Your phone asked. Check the card - the words must match: {words}
session.approved: Approved. Waiting for {name} to collect its key...
session.denied: You said no on the card, so {name} was not connected.
session.timed_out: Nobody answered the card in time, so nothing was connected. Start again.
session.expired: This code ran out of time - it works for 10 minutes. Start again.
session.burnt: Three wrong tries - this code no longer works. Start again.
session.cancelled: Pairing was cancelled, so nothing was connected.
session.refused: The card could not be approved on this PC ({why}), so nothing was connected. Start again.

devices.remove_confirm: Remove {name}? It stops reaching Jarvis at once. To use it again, pair it again with the QR code.
devices.remove_self: This phone will stop reaching Jarvis at once and go back to the pairing screen.
devices.uses_it_yourself: This phone is still using the old shared key. Pair it with the QR code first, or it would cut itself off.
devices.shared_row: Old shared key - used by this PC, and by devices paired before per-device keys.
devices.shared_retired: Retired - it now works on this PC only.
devices.shared_first_pair_row: The first device has its own key, so the old shared key now works on this PC only.
devices.unretire_first_pair: Every device has its own key now, so the old shared key cannot be let back out: that is what keeps a copied key from reaching Jarvis. To use it again, remove every device below first (each one pairs again with the QR code afterwards).
devices.unretire_waiting: Waiting for your approval. Other devices can use the old shared key again only if you approve the card, on this PC.
devices.registry_unreadable: The device list on this PC cannot be read (devices/registry.json in the Jarvis settings folder), so no device key works and only this PC can reach Jarvis. To start fresh, run  py -3 jarvis_devices.py --start-fresh  on the PC - every phone then pairs again.
devices.no_owner_check: This PC does not check approvals itself yet (jarvis_owner_check.py is not running), so a pairing card could never be approved. Run apply-patches.ps1 again.
devices.tier: pair_device is not set to "ask" in jarvis-framework.toml, so a pairing card cannot be raised.

sentences.address_off_network: Jarvis's address {address} is not on your own networks, so this app will not send your pairing key there: on this phone, use your PC's Tailscale name (ending in .ts.net) or its NordVPN Meshnet name (ending in .nord).
